dependencyRationale: Approved assets are already delivered as Compose resources; production reachability is controlled by shared screen renderers and must be verified in deterministic previews/goldens.
fallbackReason: Shared generic renderers map typed screen/item/action roles to assets across several screens, so the full compose module is fingerprinted.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0; Android SDK 37; Paparazzi 2.0.0-alpha05
